Name: Clint Reinforced
Author: m4ksos
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If you ever found vanilla Clint a little bit weird or creepy sometimes, this mod's gonna fix it and make Clint's story deeper. As well for those who ever wanted to date Clint or even marry him 'Clint Reinforced' will give you such opportunity. [/color][/size][color=#d4d4d8]There is [/color][color=#d4d4d8]a whole new look on what vanilla's Clint backstory could be. [/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]What makes him act like he does... What was his life before moving to Pelican Town... What is going on between him end Emily... You will find the answers![/b][/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]In Clint Reinforced you'll find:[/color][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]> 700 new Dialogues with Clint and other characters[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]12 new Events[/color][/size][/*]
[*]you can date and marry Clint[/*]
[*]new marriage dialogues and schedules[/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]a bit of new non-customizable Clint's Sprites and Portraits[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][color=#ffff00][size=4]Note that[/size][/color]
As well as the new emotion in Portraits, 'Clint Reinforced' has Events in which Clint's appearance changes. That why it's really advisable to keep Clint's vanilla look in the configs of 'Clint Reforged': 
[list]
[*]'Facial Hair' - 'Goatee'[/*]
[*]'Original or Revised Art' - 'Vanilla Art' or 'Revised Art'[/*]
[/list]
[color=#ffff00][size=4]P.S! [/size][/color]
'Clint Reinforced' uses SoftPandaBoi's 'Clint Reforged' as a dependency. It was my main inspiration during the development, so some sprites, portraits, spouse rooms and Events are taken and subsequently used in my mod. I give a huge thank you to SoftPandaBoi's for the mod and the opportunity to use some of its assets.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod requires 'Clint Reforged' and 'Content Patcher' to be installed.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A huge shot out to SoftPandaBoi for the inspiration![/color]

Manifest.Name: Clint Reinforced
Manifest.Description: The mod reinforces Clint as a character. Not only does it make Clint romanceable, but also adds more than 700 of new Dialogues, 13 Events and a completely new canon-style backstory. This mod is strongly inspired by SoftPandaBoi's 'Clint Reforged'.
Manifest.Author: Maksos
